# soapysdr-module-rfspace

**SoapySDR driver module for RFSpace networked receivers**

- **Version recorded:** 0.2.5
- **Categories:** `hardware`, `sdr`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/pothosware/SoapyOsmo/wiki>

## What it does

Speaks the RFSpace protocol -- SDR-IQ, SDR-IP, NetSDR, CloudIQ and the Cloud-SDR line -- and presents those receivers as SoapySDR devices, over USB or over the network depending on model.

## Why you would want it

RFSpace receivers are well-regarded HF hardware with a proprietary protocol, and outside their own software they are reachable through surprisingly little. This is what puts one in front of gqrx, SDR++ or CubicSDR. `cutesdr`, which this catalog also carries, is the vendor-adjacent client for the same hardware.

## Before it will work

RFSpace hardware. Networked models must be reachable on the network, and discovery is by broadcast, so a router in between usually means the device is not found.

## How it installs

- apt: `soapysdr-module-rfspace`

## Known problems

Built from the same `soapyosmo` source as the OsmoSDR module, so the two move together in Debian. The maintainer does not own this hardware and nothing here is maintainer-verified (D-027); it is carried because other operators have it.

## Keeping it current

- probe: apt policy
- strategy: apt_upgrade
